name: The Monster Within
body:
Prerequisites: 20th level monster trainer, master perk.

You have learned a technique that lets you wrap your essence around yourself, becoming a monster for a limited duration. In addition to calling upon a monster, you can spend 2 uses of talented trainer to cast shapechange as a spell-like ability to become any monster you have captured. You count as your own active monster for the purpose of available spells, other effects, and abilities. Once you have used this ability, you must wait 1 minute before using it again.
